known_biases.note: Membership is drawn from today's active stocks projected backwards (audit finding #2). Measured in Phase 24 on the fixed engine: survivors-only beat a survivorship-free universe by +3.00pp per fold on average, and the survivorship-free excess over NIFTY 50 is about zero (survivorship_free_confirmation).
The benchmark omits dividends; a total-return benchmark would be harder to beat.
The benchmark curve pays no transaction costs while the strategy does, understating the strategy by ~0.22pp (Phase 20 FINDINGS).
